meta.objective: Inventory the current live and local V4 artifacts, separate paper-audit assets from native conceptual-study surfaces, identify which conceptual setups can run now versus which are blocked on missing bundle/spec work, and produce implementation-facing manifests/docs for the next launch phase.

decisions.statement: Organize V4 into three inventories: live paper-audit lane, local source/build lane, and native conceptual queue.
Treat duplicate own-dev catalog rows as inventory findings to track before broader launch expansion, not as blockers for the current paper-audit read.
Keep the native conceptual queue GPT-4.1-only until a first curated conceptual universe is frozen.
